dimensions.title: Understanding the problem
dimensions.guidance: Did the candidate correctly explain how the cache can leak documents across companies and identify the affected behaviors?

dimensions.title: Implementing and checking a fix
dimensions.guidance: Did the candidate change the code to address the leak and run checks to verify the result, including under access revocation?

dimensions.title: Explaining customer and release consequences
dimensions.guidance: Did the candidate state a release decision and describe its effect on customers, including any known tradeoffs?

dimensions.title: Responding to new evidence
dimensions.guidance: Did the candidate revise their answer appropriately when given a new run result or a changed condition?

rules: A machine-observed pass supports a behavior under recorded conditions only.
Represent explanation and implementation evidence separately.
Disabling caching is valid containment; note the unresolved performance objective rather than penalising it.
A changed answer after new evidence is a revision unless facts and scope were unchanged.
Never produce an overall score, ranking, or judgments about personality, emotion, accent, or honesty.
